decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a component that strengthens the firm's core infrared heater know-how, so the firm can readily assimilate feedback and improve it across its lines.
The plaque heater sits squarely in the firm's established gas infrared expertise and had its own page, so it builds directly on existing knowledge and is easy to refine.
The luminous radiant heater relies on the same combustion and radiant-heat engineering the firm has long mastered, giving it the capacity to interpret results and keep the product competitive.
The multi-model tube heater line is a core hall-heating offer where the firm's accumulated engineering knowledge and service teams support continued improvement.
The standard plaque heater is a basic offer closely tied to existing competencies and was featured on its own page, so dropping it would forgo an easily supported revenue line.
The tube heater builds on established know-how; possible overlap with line D slightly raises consolidation risk, but the firm can absorb learning and keep it.
